info.title: Kuutti API
info.description: Free, non-commercial dating app for Finland. Every account is verified through a Finnish bank. Source: AGPL-3.0 with App Store exception.

blurhash.description: Placeholder the app paints before the thumb arrives (computed from the thumb).

rejectionReason.description: Set when state is rejected: the reason the owner is told.

appealable.description: The check rejected it and the owner may ask a person to look, once (POST /photos/{id}/appeal); never after sure nudity or a person's decision.

position.description: 0 is first in the owner's order; the main photo is the first approved one (ADR-009 §4).

caption.description: The line the owner picked for the photo (#296), or null; the words for it are the client's, per language. Null when absent, so an app that is newer than its API still reads the answer.

people.description: Faces the check counted as people present (the face threshold of ADR-006 §2).

setting.description: Indoors or outdoors when the check is sure enough of one; null otherwise.

scene.description: Where, the surest first; each a key of photos.description.scene.

objects.description: Activities, animals and objects, the surest first; each a key of photos.description.object.

description.description: What the photo check saw in the photo (#296), or null before the check ran or where none runs. Null when absent, so an app that is newer than its API still reads the answer.

decidedByStaff.description: True when a person decided, false when the automatic check did or nobody did in time (not_reviewed).

ExportedPhotoReview.description: The moderation outcome; label names are not part of it.

PhotoVariant.description: thumb: 200×200 for lists. card: 800×1067 when a profile is opened. full: 1600 px long edge, requested only from the zoom screen.

about.description: What this part is, in the request's language.

reason.description: The kind in words, in the request's language.

photosNotShown.description: Oldest first; each goes after twelve months.

carefulCheckUntil.description: Until when new photos are checked more carefully; null when they are not.

lookedAtAgain.description: Whether a second member of staff reviewed it.

PhotoDescription.description: What the photo check sees in the photo, as keys the client renders in the viewer's language (#296). Read with the photo by screen readers, after the owner's caption; shown under it when the viewer asks.

about.description: What this part is, in the request's language.

status.description: ok when the database answers and migrations are current; degraded otherwise.

commit.description: Short git commit the build was made from.

source.description: Where the source of the running service is published (AGPL-3.0 section 13), to be read with `commit`. A modified deployment points this at its own source.

migrations.description: Committed migrations compared with the ones applied to this database.

sessionId.description: This device's session; the app keeps it with the tokens.

refreshToken.description: Single use: /auth/refresh answers with a new pair and retires this one.

refreshExpiresAt.description: After this the device logs in through the bank again.

outcome.description: created: a fresh account (first login or after a cooldown); resumed: the live account; unpaused: the live account, back from a break (#170).

code.description: The one-time code the deep link carried.

sessionId.description: This device's session; the app keeps it with the tokens.

refreshToken.description: Single use: /auth/refresh answers with a new pair and retires this one.

refreshExpiresAt.description: After this the device logs in through the bank again.

confirmed.description: True once the person typed the code sent to this address; a new address is unconfirmed.

codeExpiresAt.description: When the code waiting for this address stops working; null when none waits (none sent, used, spent or expired).

code.description: The six digits of the message sent to the address.

confirm.description: Must be true: the person confirmed in the app.
Must be true: the person said they understand what a break means.

scene.description: Where, the surest first; each a key of photos.description.scene.

photo.description: The picture, pre-resized to 1600 px by the app; JPEG, PNG or WebP.

ConsentVersions.description: The consent_version of the current wording per kind.

accountId.description: The account of the card the person was shown.
The account of the card the person was shown.

canInvite.description: True once the person's profile has passed the pond gate's test.

redeemable.description: True while the person may still type a code: before their profile first passed the gate's test, with the current consents, no code used, and an identity never erased.

reward.description: What an invitation earns today (matching_config invitation_reward), for the app's words.

earned.description: What the person's invitations earned that is not used yet.

code.description: Two groups of five; shown once, here. Kuutti keeps only its hash.
As typed: case, spaces and hyphens do not matter, and O reads as 0, I and L as 1.

photo.description: The picture, pre-resized to 1600 px by the app; JPEG, PNG or WebP.

get.summary: Liveness and readiness in one answer
get.description: 200 when the database answers and committed migrations are applied; 503 with the same body when either fails.

Opened in the system browser by the app, with the SHA-256 of the app's verifier for this attempt (code_challenge, ADR-027). Redirects to the identification broker's bank chooser; the person comes back through /auth/callback and the app receives a one-time code by deep link.

schema.description: The app that will receive the one-time code by deep link.

parameters.description: The app that will receive the one-time code by deep link.
parameters.name: platform

schema.description: The language of the bank chooser (ui_locales); defaults to the request's.

parameters.description: The language of the bank chooser (ui_locales); defaults to the request's.
parameters.name: locale

schema.description: SHA-256 of this attempt's verifier, lowercase hex (ADR-027): only the app holding the verifier can exchange the code.

parameters.description: SHA-256 of this attempt's verifier, lowercase hex (ADR-027): only the app holding the verifier can exchange the code.
parameters.name: code_challenge

302.description: Redirect to the broker; where none is configured (a pull-request preview, ADR-014 §1), to kuutti://auth?error=auth_unavailable; when this address has sent too many requests or started too many sign-ins, or too many are under way at once (ADR-026), to kuutti://auth?error=auth_rate_limited with Retry-After.

503.description: No identification broker is configured (anywhere but a preview).

get.description: The registered redirect URI. Exchanges the code with the broker, derives the identity, applies the re-registration rule and redirects to the app's deep link with a one-time code. A state is answered once: its second return, at once or later, is auth_state_mismatch without a call to the broker. Never called by the app itself.

302.description: Redirect to kuutti://auth?code=… on success, or to kuutti://auth?error=<code> (auth_state_mismatch, auth_cancelled, auth_under_18, auth_banned, auth_suspended with &until=<date> when the suspension has an end, auth_cooldown with &until=<date>, auth_provider_error) so the app shows the refusal.

post.summary: Exchange the one-time code for a session
post.description: Single use, within 60 seconds of the callback, and only with the verifier whose SHA-256 the attempt's /auth/start carried (ADR-027); a wrong verifier leaves the code unspent. Answers with this device's access and refresh tokens; the app keeps both in secure storage.

401.description: Unknown, used or expired code, or a verifier that is not its attempt's (auth_code_used).

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this address (ADR-026 §1); Retry-After is the wait.

post.description: Presents the refresh token, receives a new pair; the old refresh token is retired. Presenting a retired token ends the device's session (session_revoked): sign in through the bank again.

401.description: Retired, revoked, expired or unknown refresh token (session_revoked).

204.description: The session is ended; both tokens stop working.

post.description: Recovery for a lost phone: every session of the account ends, including this one.

204.description: Every session of the account is ended.

get.description: Opened by the moderation panel. The same bank login as the app's, marked as a staff attempt: it resolves to an identity with a moderator role and creates nothing. The browser returns to the panel with a one-time code in the URL fragment, or with error=admin_not_allowed.

schema.description: The language of the bank chooser; defaults to the request's.

parameters.description: The language of the bank chooser; defaults to the request's.
parameters.name: locale

302.description: Redirect to the broker; when this address has sent too many requests or started too many sign-ins, or too many are under way at once (ADR-026), to the panel with error=auth_rate_limited in the fragment and Retry-After.

post.summary: Exchange a staff one-time code for an admin session
post.description: Single use, within 60 seconds. Eight hours, no refresh; sign in again afterwards.

403.description: admin_not_allowed: the role was taken away meanwhile.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this address (ADR-026 §1); Retry-After is the wait.

200.description: The role and when the session ends.

204.description: The session is ended.

get.description: The optional e-mail of #148 (TD-18): a way for Kuutti to stay in touch (#385), never a login, never shown to anybody. Null when none is set; whether it is confirmed, and until when a code waits for it (ADR-043).

200.description: The e-mail, or null, and its confirmation.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

put.description: Validated as an address. A different address than the one stored is unconfirmed, and a code waiting for the old one goes; the same address again changes nothing. Nothing is sent: the app asks for a code with POST /account/email/code (ADR-043). The value reaches no log line and no event.

200.description: Set; the address and its confirmation.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

204.description: Cleared.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

post.summary: Send a code to the caller's unconfirmed e-mail
post.description: Six digits to the stored address, in the request's language (#385, ADR-043), replacing any code that waits, good for matching_config email_code_minutes and email_code_attempts. At most email_codes_per_day per Finnish day. Neither the address nor the code reaches a log line.

200.description: Sent; until when the code works.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

409.description: email_none: no address is set; email_confirmed: the address is confirmed already.

429.description: email_code_budget_exceeded: the day's codes are sent; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

503.description: mail_unavailable: no mail is sent in this environment, or the send failed; nothing was counted.

post.summary: Confirm the caller's e-mail with its code
post.description: The six digits of the last code sent (#385, ADR-043). Right, the address is confirmed and the code goes; the same answer when it is confirmed already.

400.description: validation_failed: not six digits; email_code_wrong: not the code, and a try remains.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

409.description: email_none: no address is set; email_code_none: no code waits (none sent, or the address changed); email_code_expired: past its minutes; email_code_spent: its last attempt was wrong.

post.description: Erasure per TD-7: every session, login attempt, photo (with its objects unless another account shares them), review row and fetch log entry goes; the account row stays as an anonymised tombstone and the identity keeps a deletion count and a 30-day cooldown before a new account. The audit log is untouched. The body confirms; the app asks first.

204.description: Erased. Every token of this account has stopped working.

404.description: No live account: a second deletion that passed the session guard before the first committed (not_found).

get.summary: Whether the caller told Kuutti they found somebody
get.description: "Löysin hänet" (#83, ADR-040): whether this account has answered, so the screen can thank the person instead of asking again. Never which reason: the account does not keep it.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

post.description: "Löysin hänet" (#83, ADR-040): the reason, from a closed list, counted once per account in an anonymous daily count that names nobody, and a research event for those who said yes to research. An indication only: nothing else changes, no state, no session, no round, no conversation.

204.description: Counted.

400.description: Validation failed (a reason outside the list).

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

409.description: found_them_answered: this account told Kuutti already; nothing was counted.

post.summary: Take a break: pause this account
post.description: The account goes to paused (#170, ADR-022): the profile leaves every pool, counter and round, and every session of the account ends, this one included. Nothing is erased: the profile, the photos, the preferences, the consents and the place at the gate stay as they are, and the next bank login brings the account back as it was. The body confirms; the screen asks first.

204.description: Paused. Every token of this account has stopped working.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

409.description: not_active: onboarding is not finished, so there is nothing to hide yet; already_paused: another device paused the account first.

get.summary: Everything Kuutti holds about this account
get.description: One zip, named <stem>-<date>.zip in the request's language: a JSON document (the AccountExport schema) with the account, the identity's dates and login level, the devices signed in, the photos with their moderation outcome and the person's own fetch log, and beside it photos/<photo id>.webp, the full-size file of every profile photo whose object the store holds and of the newest hundred photos the person sent in conversations, whose lines carry each one's moderation outcome and description. Nothing about anyone else. At most matching_config exports_per_day copies per Finnish calendar day; each photo read is logged as a fetch of the full variant, a sent photo's with the purpose message, never counted.

200.description: The zip; Content-Disposition names the file.

schema.description: The zip with the document and the photos.

404.description: No live account: erased between the session guard and the record (not_found).

429.description: export_budget_exceeded: the day's copies are used up; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

get.description: In the owner's order, with the blurhash to paint before the bytes arrive.

200.description: The caller's own photos, with the advisory tips that apply to them, highest priority first (the app shows one at a time), and the fish the fish tip names, or null.

post.description: Multipart with one part named photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB). The API validates, strips metadata, re-encodes into three WebP variants and keeps no original. The photo is pending until moderation; the owner sees it, nobody else.

400.description: Validation failed (no photo part, or not an accepted type).

404.description: not_found: the account was erased while the photo was processed.

409.description: photo_limit: the account has max_photos photos already.

415.description: photo_unsupported: the bytes are not a JPEG, PNG or WebP.

422.description: photo_too_many_pixels or photo_invalid: refused before or by the decoder.

503.description: media_busy with Retry-After: image processing is at capacity; or media_unavailable.

204.description: Gone, along with its objects when nothing else shared them.

404.description: Not a photo of this account.

post.summary: Ask a person to look at the check's rejection
post.description: Once per photo, for a photo the automatic check rejected (`appealable`); never after a nudity label the check was very sure of, or a person's decision. The photo goes back to the queue and stays unseen by others until a person approves it.

404.description: Not a photo of this account.

409.description: photo_not_appealable: not the check's own rejection, or appealed already.

put.summary: Set the caption of a photo
put.description: A line from a closed list, shown under the photo to others in their own language (#296); null clears it. A key, never the person's text, so nothing is checked.

400.description: Validation failed: not a line of the list.

404.description: Not a photo of this account.

put.summary: Set the order of the photos
put.description: Every photo of the account exactly once, first to last. The main photo is the first approved one in this order (ADR-009 §4).

200.description: The photos in the new order, with the advisory tips that apply to them now that the main photo may have changed, highest priority first (the app shows one at a time), and the fish the fish tip names, or null.

get.summary: A signed URL for one variant
get.description: Valid for fifteen minutes. Every issuance is logged against the caller and counted against the day's budget for the variant (matching_config.photo_fetches_per_day; the day rolls at midnight in Finland). The app caches by photo id and variant, never by this URL, and asks for full only from the zoom screen. Another account's photo is served only from a card the caller was shown.

parameters.description: thumb: 200×200 for lists. card: 800×1067 when a profile is opened. full: 1600 px long edge, requested only from the zoom screen.
parameters.name: variant

200.description: The URL and when it stops working.

404.description: Not a photo this account may see: not its own, and not on a card it was shown.

429.description: photo_budget_exceeded: the day's fetches of this variant are used up; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

503.description: media_unavailable: no object storage is configured here.

get.summary: Photos waiting for a person's decision
get.description: Oldest first, with what the automatic check saw: labels with confidences, faces, what was flagged.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.summary: A signed URL for the card variant, for review
get.description: Any photo, any state. Every issuance is an audit_log row naming the member of staff.

200.description: The URL and when it stops working.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such photo.

503.description: media_unavailable: no object storage is configured here.

post.description: approve makes the photo visible to others; reject hides it and tells the owner the reason in words. Only a queued photo takes a decision, once. Only a person rejects. Written to audit_log.

400.description: Validation failed (a rejection without a reason, for example).

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such photo.

409.description: photo_not_queued: the photo is not waiting for a decision (already decided, or still being checked).

get.summary: The caller's profile and what it still needs
get.description: The profile as saved (null before the first save) and the completeness rule's verdict (what is missing before the profile can enter a round).

put.description: The whole document every time: display name, a bio or a placeholder, the fields from the registry, up to three prompts. A politics or religion answer needs the special-category consent on record, which is given at the seeks step and withdrawn in Settings (the consent routes), never in this body. Free text passes the plain-text rule: no e-mail, URL, phone number or social handle.

200.description: Saved; the profile as stored, with its completeness.

400.description: Validation failed, or text_contact_details (a field carries an e-mail, URL, phone number or handle).

403.description: consent_required: a politics or religion answer without the consent of the current wording (ADR-019); the detail names the fields and the current version.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

get.summary: The caller's own card, as others will see it
get.description: The card built the way a round builds it for someone else, with the age from the bank-verified year and month, the approved photos in order (bytes through GET /photos/{id}/{variant}) and what is still missing. Nothing is recorded: this is the owner looking at themselves.

200.description: The card, or null before the first save.

get.summary: What the caller has answered and which steps of onboarding are still open
get.description: The steps of the field sheet in the order the app asks them, the answers so far, the consents given for the current wordings and the current versions. An account without a pond is put in the default pond here. When the four answers matching needs and the two consents are there and the account is still registered, it becomes active here; the profile steps keep `complete` false until they are done.

put.description: Self-declared, one of a closed list (rule 3); nothing from the bank informs it.

204.description: Declared.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

get.summary: Every consent the caller has given, and the current versions

post.summary: Record a consent for the current wording
post.description: The kind (terms, privacy, research, or special_category for whom one seeks, politics and religion), the consent_version the person read and the language it was shown in. An old version is refused with agreement_outdated; the same consent twice is recorded once.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

409.description: agreement_outdated: the wording has a newer version.

429.description: too_many_changes: the research opt-in was given and withdrawn more than the day allows.

delete.summary: Withdraw the research opt-in or the special-category consent
delete.description: The two consents a person withdraws; terms and privacy end with the account. Withdrawing special_category takes whom the person seeks and the politics and religion of the profile with it, and onboarding asks the seek question again. The rows stay as the record of what was agreed and when.

400.description: Validation failed: not a kind a person withdraws.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

post.description: A kind (bug, idea, complaint, praise) and a few lines, with the app's version, the platform and the language the app read. Stored for the moderators' panel; the text reaches no log line and no research event. At most matching_config feedback_per_day a day per account, the Finnish calendar day.

204.description: Stored.

400.description: Validation failed: an unknown kind, an empty or too long text, an unknown platform.

404.description: No live account: erased between the session guard and the record (not_found).

429.description: feedback_budget_exceeded: the day's feedback is sent; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

get.description: The unhandled rows: a bug first and praise last, the oldest first within a kind, with the app's version, the platform and the language the app read, and the sender's account id.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

post.description: A moderator read it. Once; written to audit_log with the kind.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such feedback.

409.description: feedback_handled: already marked.

post.summary: Block the person of a card one was shown
post.description: From then on neither is shown to the other, in either direction, in any round, card, photo or pool. Between the two identities, so it holds for a later account of either; final. Nobody is told.

204.description: The block stands: set now, set before, or set by the other first, alike.

400.description: Validation failed: a missing or malformed account id, an unknown key.

404.description: not_found: no card of that account was shown to the caller and no block stands between the two accounts (never shown, oneself, nobody, a later account of somebody blocked), or the caller was erased meanwhile; nothing is written.

post.summary: Report the person of a card one was shown, and block them
post.description: A reason from the closed list and, if the person likes, a few lines for the moderators, who read it in the panel. The report blocks both ways in the same transaction. The reported person learns nothing. At most matching_config reports_per_day a day per account, the Finnish calendar day; one open report per pair.

204.description: Filed and blocked; or a report of the same person is still open, and nothing more is written.

400.description: Validation failed: a missing or unknown reason, a note blank or over 500 characters, a malformed account id, an unknown key.

404.description: not_found: no card of that account was shown to the caller and no block stands between the two accounts (never shown, oneself, nobody, a later account of somebody blocked), or the caller was erased meanwhile; nothing is written.

429.description: report_budget_exceeded: the day's reports are filed and nothing was written, the block neither; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

post.summary: Block the other person of a conversation
post.description: The block both ways and the conversation's close in one transaction (#351): from then on the conversation is gone for the caller, who gets 404 for it from every other route, and ended for the other person, who is not told why. The block holds everywhere a card's does, between the identities, and is final. Blocking again answers the same, the conversation then hidden from the caller.

204.description: The block stands: set now, or set before; alike when the other person deleted their account meanwhile, and nothing is written.

400.description: validation_failed: the id is not a uuid.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller (not theirs, or nobody's), or the caller was erased meanwhile; nothing is written.

post.summary: Report the other person of a conversation, with a copy of it, and block them
post.description: The card's reason and note (#351, ADR-030 §12). In one transaction: the report naming the conversation, a frozen copy of every message it holds now, both people's, for the moderators, who read it in the panel, the block both ways and the conversation's close. Taken while the conversation is open or archived, and for matching_config report_after_close_days after it closed, so a person blocked can still report what was said. At most matching_config reports_per_day a day, one open report per pair, as from a card. The reported person learns nothing.

204.description: Filed, copied, blocked and closed; or a report of the same person is still open, and nothing more is written.

400.description: Validation failed: a missing or unknown reason, a note blank or over 500 characters, an unknown key, an id that is not a uuid.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller (not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other), or the caller was erased meanwhile; nothing is written.

409.description: report_window_closed: the conversation closed longer ago than report_after_close_days, or the other person deleted their account; nothing is written.

429.description: report_budget_exceeded: the day's reports are filed and nothing was written, the block neither; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

get.summary: What the caller may be notified of
get.description: Every kind (a new round, a message, a match, a moderator's decision), in that order, each on unless the person switched it off. The push reads it for the round, a message and a match; nothing is sent for a moderator's decision yet.

200.description: Every kind and whether it is on.

put.summary: Switch one kind of notification on or off

200.description: Every kind as it now stands.

400.description: validation_failed: an unknown kind, enabled not a boolean, an unknown key.

404.description: not_found: the account was erased while the request was on its way.

get.summary: The caller's notices in the app
get.description: What must reach the person even without a push, newest first, at most 20: a moderator's warning, with its reason, until it is lifted, and an invitation of the person's that counted, with what it earned and never who was invited. A notice holds no text of its own; the app says it.

post.summary: Mark one of the caller's notices read

204.description: Read, now or before.

400.description: validation_failed: the id is not a uuid.

404.description: not_found: no such notice of the caller's.

put.description: The caller's session's Expo push token, which its pushes go to (ADR-055): one per session, replacing the session's earlier one, and taken from any other session it was registered to. The pushes are worded in the request's language. It goes when the session ends. A session revoked meanwhile writes nothing.

204.description: Registered, or nothing to register for a session that ended.

400.description: validation_failed: not an Expo push token, an unknown platform, an unknown key.

get.description: Whether the caller may invite (their profile has passed the pond gate's test) and may still type a code, what an invitation earns today (matching_config invitation_reward), their open invitations newest first, how many of theirs have counted, and what those earned that is not used yet. Never a code, and nothing of anybody invited.

404.description: not_found: the account was erased while the request was on its way.

post.description: A code for one friend, in two groups of five, shown here once: Kuutti keeps only its hash. For a caller whose profile has passed the pond gate's test; at most matching_config invitations_open open at once. The night the friend's profile first passes the same test, the invitation counts and the caller earns matching_config invitation_reward.

201.description: Made; the code is not shown again.

404.description: not_found: the account was erased while the request was on its way.

409.description: invitation_not_yet: the caller's profile has not passed the pond gate's test; invitations_full: as many invitations open as matching_config invitations_open allows. Nothing was written.

204.description: Withdrawn: its code works no more.

400.description: validation_failed: the id is not a uuid.

404.description: not_found: no open invitation of the caller's: redeemed, another's or none.

post.description: A code typed by the caller, before their profile first passes the pond gate's test: case, spaces and hyphens do not matter. The caller is checked before the code is looked up. At most matching_config invitation_tries_per_day tries a Finnish day, whatever their answer.

204.description: Redeemed: the invitation counts the night the caller's profile passes the test.

400.description: validation_failed: no code, too long, not a code, or an unknown key.

404.description: invitation_unknown: no open invitation has that code; one used or the caller's own answers the same. not_found: the account was erased meanwhile.

409.description: invitation_not_for_you: the caller cannot use a code: their profile has passed the test, they used one already, the current terms and privacy consents are not given, or their identity had an account erased before.

429.description: invitation_tries_exceeded: the day's tries are used; Retry-After is the wait until midnight in Finland.

get.description: Open conversations, then the archived and the closed ones, each newest first by the last message the caller may read, else by the opening. Each with the counterpart (name, age and the main photo's thumb, signed for fifteen minutes and logged as a fetch; or deleted), the last message's first characters and the unread count. With thumbs=false, no thumb is signed.

400.description: Validation failed: thumbs other than true or false, an unknown key.

get.description: The summary, the longest message the composer may send, the highest sequence the counterpart has read, and the contacts (#103): the caller's stored pieces, each shared here or not, and the counterpart's pieces shared with the caller now. In a closed conversation nothing is shared either way.

400.description: Validation failed: the id is not a uuid.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

get.description: With before, the messages under that sequence, newest first; with after, the ones above it, oldest first (what is new since the last one the phone holds); with neither, the newest. At most limit, 50 by default, 100 at most. A counterpart's message sent during a shadow ban still open is not among them.

400.description: Validation failed: before and after together, a sequence or a limit out of range, an unknown key.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

post.description: In one transaction: the conversation's row locked, the next sequence taken, the last message's time set and the archive left. A clientId already stored answers 200 with that message and writes nothing. At most matching_config messages_per_minute a minute per account, message_max_length characters after trimming, and no e-mail address, link, phone number or handle.

200.description: Sent before: the stored message, nothing written.

400.description: validation_failed (an empty body, a malformed client id, an unknown key, a client id the other side used); message_too_long (over message_max_length after trimming); contact_details (an e-mail address, a link, a phone number or a handle).

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

409.description: conversation_closed: closed, a block stands between the two, or the counterpart deleted their account; nothing was written.

429.description: message_budget_exceeded: the minute's messages are sent; Retry-After is the wait.

post.description: One request uploads and sends (#350): the picture through the photo pipeline (validated, EXIF stripped, re-encoded, the variants, the original never stored), the automatic check before anything is stored, then the photo and its message in one transaction, as a text is sent. A clientId already stored answers 200 with that message and writes nothing. The caption follows the text's rules. At most matching_config message_photos_per_day a Finnish day, and the send counts against messages_per_minute. A Finnish day also counts the sends tried, refused ones included (matching_config message_photo_attempts_per_day). The answer carries the photo's thumb and full size, signed until the next five-minute mark plus fifteen minutes.

200.description: Sent before: the stored message, nothing written.

400.description: validation_failed (no picture, a type other than JPEG, PNG or WebP, a malformed client id, an unknown field, a client id the other side used); message_too_long and contact_details for the caption; photo_rejected_nudity, photo_rejected_violence or photo_rejected_other: the check was sure, and nothing was stored.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

409.description: conversation_closed: closed, a block stands between the two, or the counterpart deleted their account; nothing was stored.

415.description: photo_unsupported: not a picture the pipeline reads.

429.description: message_budget_exceeded (the minute's messages) or message_photo_budget_exceeded (the day's photos, or the day's tries, matching_config message_photo_attempts_per_day, both until midnight in Finland); Retry-After is the wait.

503.description: media_busy (the pipeline at capacity, or the check unavailable; Retry-After) or media_unavailable (no object storage here).

get.description: Up to one phone number, WhatsApp number, Telegram and Instagram username, in that order, each in its stored form. Nobody else sees them until the caller shares one in a conversation.

put.description: Stores the piece of that kind in its one form (normaliseContact: a number in E.164, a Finnish one from 0 to +358; a username without its @, Instagram's in lower case), replacing the one kept before. A shared piece that changes shows its new value in the conversations where it is shared, at once. Counts against matching_config messages_per_minute.

400.description: validation_failed (an unknown kind, an empty value or one over 64 characters, an unknown key); contact_invalid: not one of its kind (the detail names the kind, never the value).

404.description: not_found: the account was deleted while the request was on its way.

429.description: message_budget_exceeded: the minute's messages, shares and contact changes are spent; Retry-After is the wait.

delete.description: Deletes the piece of that kind and, in the same transaction, ends every share of it: it disappears from those conversations at once. Answered alike when none was kept. Counts against matching_config messages_per_minute.

204.description: Removed, or none was kept.

404.description: not_found: the account was deleted, or taken out of the live states, while the request was on its way; nothing was written.

429.description: message_budget_exceeded: the minute's messages, shares and contact changes are spent; Retry-After is the wait.

get.summary: What is shared in one conversation
get.description: The detail's contacts alone, by the same rule: the caller's stored pieces, each shared here or not, and the counterpart's pieces shared with the caller now. What the phone reads on a contacts frame and on a resume: it signs no thumb and writes nothing.

400.description: validation_failed: the id is not a uuid.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

post.summary: Share a contact in the conversation
post.description: The other person sees the caller's stored piece of that kind at once, in the conversation's detail, until the caller stops sharing it, removes or changes it, or the conversation closes. In one transaction, as a send: the conversation's row locked, its state read afresh. A share standing already writes nothing. A share brings an archived conversation back. Counts against matching_config messages_per_minute. The answer is the caller's fresh view of the conversation.

400.description: validation_failed: the id is not a uuid, or an unknown kind.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

409.description: conversation_closed (closed, a block stands between the two, or the counterpart deleted their account) or contact_not_stored (no piece of that kind is kept); nothing was written.

429.description: message_budget_exceeded: the minute's messages, shares and contact changes are spent; Retry-After is the wait.

delete.summary: Stop sharing a contact in the conversation
delete.description: The caller's share of that kind there ends, and the other person no longer sees it. Nothing standing answers alike, a closed conversation too. Counts against matching_config messages_per_minute. The answer is the caller's fresh view of the conversation.

400.description: validation_failed: the id is not a uuid, or an unknown kind.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

429.description: message_budget_exceeded: the minute's messages, shares and contact changes are spent; Retry-After is the wait.

post.summary: End the conversation for both, blocking nobody
post.description: The conversation closes for both people (#351): neither can write in it, both read it as ended, with nothing saying who ended it or how, and both may still report it for matching_config report_after_close_days. What either shared there ends with it. One closed already is left as it is.

204.description: Ended, or ended before.

400.description: validation_failed: the id is not a uuid.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

post.summary: Mark the conversation read up to a sequence
post.description: The caller's read mark goes up to upTo, never down and never past the newest message.

204.description: Marked.

400.description: Validation failed: not a whole sequence from zero, an unknown key.

404.description: not_found: no such conversation for the caller: not theirs, nobody's, or hidden from the one who blocked the other.

get.summary: The automatic shadow bans waiting for a moderator
get.description: The shadow bans an automatic rule applied (#105) that nobody has confirmed, reversed or lifted, oldest first, never the reader's own: the rule, what it counted and since when; counts and times only. With the API's clock and matching_config auto_shadow_ban_review_hours, past which one is late; it stays until a moderator decides. Confirm and reverse are POST /admin/sanctions/{id}/review. Moderators and admins; no audit row.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.description: Newest first: the account's own and the identity's bans set on any of its accounts, with staff's notes and who did what by identity id and their role now (null once the role is gone, or for what no person did).

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such account.

post.summary: Warn, shadow-ban or suspend a person
post.description: A reason from the closed list and a note of at most 500 characters; a suspension also its end, a day after today in Finland and at most 366 days ahead. A suspension ends every session. A ban is POST /admin/accounts/{id}/bans, for admins.

400.description: Validation failed, or ends_on_invalid: the end is not after today or too far ahead.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such account.

409.description: account_deleted: only a ban binds an erased account; staff_target: a member of staff loses the role first.

post.description: Admins only. On the identity, for good until an admin lifts it: every session ends, the bank login is refused, and no new account is possible. An erased account's identity can be banned too.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such account.

409.description: staff_target: a member of staff loses the role first.

post.summary: Lift a warning, a shadow ban or a suspension
post.description: The account is settled from what is still open; no session comes back, the person signs in again. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such sanction here (a ban is lifted on its own route).

409.description: sanction_lifted: already lifted; own_account: nobody lifts a sanction on themselves.

post.description: A second member of staff's note, and keep or lift. Somebody other than who applied it; once. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such sanction here (a ban is reviewed on its own route).

409.description: own_sanction: applied by the same person; own_account: a sanction on the reviewer; sanction_reviewed: looked at already; sanction_lifted: a lift of a lifted one.

post.description: The account is settled from what is still open; no session comes back, the person signs in again. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such ban.

409.description: sanction_lifted: already lifted; own_account: nobody lifts a sanction on themselves.

post.description: A second member of staff's note, and keep or lift. Somebody other than who applied it; once. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such ban.

409.description: own_sanction: applied by the same person; own_account: a sanction on the reviewer; sanction_reviewed: looked at already; sanction_lifted: a lift of a lifted one.

get.description: Each key of matching_config with its latest value, which every reader uses, and its versions newest first: the value, from when, by whom and why. Admins only.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

post.description: A new version of the key with the admin's reason, used from the next request on. The value keeps the current one's JSON type, and an object its keys. Keys are born in migrations. Admins only; written to audit_log.

400.description: Validation failed, or config_shape: the value changes the current one's type or keys.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such key.

409.description: config_conflict: another admin changed the key meanwhile.

get.description: Per queue (reports not decided that the reader is no party to, the automatic shadow bans nobody has confirmed or reversed but the reader's own, photos waiting for a person, feedback not handled), how many wait and since when the oldest; the API's clock; matching_config moderation_response_hours, past which the oldest is late, and auto_shadow_ban_review_hours, the automatic bans' own. And the association's measure (#83): how many told Kuutti they found somebody, by reason, over the last thirty Finnish days and in all, from a count that names nobody. Moderators and admins.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.description: Open reports the oldest first, those about one account together, the group whose oldest waited longest first; or closed ones, the newest decision first. Each with its reason, where it was made, both account ids, the reporter's reports filed and upheld, and the reported account's reports received and sanctions. A report the reading member of staff is a party to is left out, and out of every count. With the API's clock and matching_config moderation_response_hours. Moderators and admins.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.summary: One report, with the reporter's note and the frozen conversation
get.description: The queue's item, the reporter's note, the decision, the frozen copy of the conversation for a report made from one (null for a card's), and the sanctions that may close it while it waits. Written first to audit_log, about the report: conversation.view for a conversation's report, report.view for a card's; a look whose row cannot be written answers nothing of it. Moderators and admins.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: not_found: no such report, or one the reader is a party to, answered alike.

get.summary: A signed URL for a photo of a report's frozen conversation
get.description: The full variant of the photo the copy holds at that line, for fifteen minutes. Every issuance is a photo.view row about the report, written before the URL is signed. Moderators and admins.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: not_found: no such report, a party's, or no photo at that line, answered alike.

503.description: media_unavailable: no object storage is configured here.

post.description: Dismissed, or acted on naming the sanction applied for it: one on the reported account, or a ban of its identity, at or after the filing, applied by a person or applied by an automatic rule and kept by a person on review (#105). Once; written to audit_log as report.decide. Tells nobody. Moderators and admins.

400.description: Validation failed: acted without a sanction, or dismissed with one.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: not_found: no such report, or one the reader is a party to, answered alike.

409.description: report_decided: decided already; sanction_not_for_report: the sanction does not answer this report.

get.description: One account by its id: its raw state and the identity's standing, the profile as the card shows it, the photos (the pictures by GET /admin/photos/{id}/card), the feedback the person sent, and the audit rows about them. Never the hash, the broker's ids, the research id or the e-mail. An erased account answers its deletion date and nothing else. Every look is an audit row.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such account.

get.summary: The audit log, a page at a time
get.description: Who did or saw what, newest first, 50 rows a page; narrowed by actor, action, subject type and id, and a time window; `before` is the `next` of the page before. Never more than a page. Admins only; a read narrowed to a subject id writes audit.read about it first, any other read writes nothing.

400.description: Validation failed, or cursor_invalid: a cursor this route did not give.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.description: Every member of staff by identity id: the role, when and by whom it was granted, the last sign-in to the panel. Granting and revoking stay the maintainer's tool. Admins only.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.summary: Where the caller stands at the pond gate
get.description: Between a finished profile and the first round (TD-10): on the pond's waitlist with a place, let in and waiting for enough people who match (how many more, in steps of `step`), or open. Counted nightly, and once when a person with a finished profile first asks.

Per pond: bank-verified people waiting, their split by self-declared gender, and how many are finishing their profile. A number is published only where at least k people stand behind it (k is in the answer), the split only when every cell is at least k, and a pond's numbers move only once at least k people have come or gone since they were last said. Counted once a day. No session needed.

200.description: Every pond with what may be said of it.

get.summary: The ponds a person can choose
get.description: Every pond with both Finnish case forms (TD-17), parents first. Where matching happens (TD-10); the choice is one per account.

204.description: Chosen.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

get.description: The Finnish day and its cards in order, each with why it is there and the caller's own decision. The first read of a day builds the caller's round once their matching has opened; entries null while they have none, an empty list for a round with nobody to show. A card that cannot be shown now is left out. Serving a card writes the shown record and counts against matching_config exposure_cards_per_day (ADR-008).

429.description: card_budget_exceeded: the day's cards are used up; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

post.description: The phone had the card on the screen. The first report is recorded; a repeat writes nothing. A decision does not need it.

204.description: Recorded, or recorded before.

404.description: not_found: no round today, no card at that place, a card that can no longer be shown, or a day not begun.

409.description: round_expired: the day named has ended; nothing was written.

put.description: Recorded, or replacing the day's earlier decision on the card; the same decision again writes nothing. A day that has ended answers round_expired. A like counts against the day's matching_config like_budget_balanced, except one on a liked_you or fish card; a pass never does. A like of somebody whose like of the caller stands is a match: the answer names its conversation, and that like is final. A fish is a like with a mark, matching_config fish_budget of them in any fish_window_days; on a liked_you or fish card it is a like. Past either budget, a like or a fish the caller's invitations earned is used by itself, left out of the counts after, and given back when the decision changes the same day.

200.description: Recorded, with the conversation the card's like is part of, or null for a pass and a like that made no match.

404.description: not_found: no round today, no card at that place, a card that can no longer be shown, or a day not begun.

409.description: round_expired: the day named has ended; match_made: the card's like made a match and stays. Nothing was written.

429.description: like_budget_exceeded: the day's likes are used up and no earned like is left, Retry-After the wait until the day rolls; fish_budget_exceeded: matching_config fish_budget fish were sent within fish_window_days and no earned fish is left, Retry-After the wait until the next can go. Nothing was written.

get.summary: What today's round may relax, and what is relaxed
get.description: For a short round (fewer ordered places than matching_config round_size, the liked-you and fish places aside), every deal-breaker of the caller's that is not paused and not relaxed today, each way it can be relaxed for the day: unanswered (let through those who did not answer its field) and aside (set it aside), each listed only when it would add somebody today, with more: how much it widens the caller's pool, rounded down to a step of matching_config waitlist_k. Counted on asking. Also the relaxations in force today. Never another filter (ADR-042).

404.description: not_found: no round today, or a day not begun.

409.description: round_expired: the day named has ended; nothing was written.

post.description: One of the caller's own deal-breakers loosened for the day only: the people it lets in today are added after the round's last place, as many as the room left (round_size less the ordered places), new people first, reason relaxed with the field. Tomorrow's round is built from the filters as stored. The answer is the cards added, served as the round's read serves them (ADR-008).

200.description: Relaxed; the cards it added, perhaps none.

404.description: not_found: no round today, a day not begun, or a relaxation the offers would not list (no deal-breaker of the caller's on that field, a paused one, or unanswered where those people are let through already). Nothing was written.

409.description: round_expired: the day named has ended; already_relaxed: that deal-breaker is relaxed today; relaxations_changed: another device relaxed or undid one since this tap's offers were counted. Nothing was written.

429.description: card_budget_exceeded: relaxed, and the cards added, but the day's cards are used up; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

delete.summary: Undo today's relaxation of a deal-breaker
delete.description: The relaxation goes, and with it the cards that came in under it, a later relaxation's too, that are still undecided; a decided one stays as it was decided.

200.description: Undone; the places of the cards removed.

404.description: not_found: no round today, a day not begun, or that field not relaxed today.

409.description: round_expired: the day named has ended; nothing was written.

get.description: Each with whether it is paused: a deal-breaker waits while the person's own answer on its field is missing (#149, the disclose-to-filter rule). `max` is how many a person may have.

put.description: The whole set, at most `max`, each on a distinct whitelisted field the person has answered themselves, accepting options the field has. Hard rows: #87 applies them in the pool, both ways.

400.description: Validation failed: more than allowed, a field twice, or an answer the field has not.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

409.description: filter_unanswered: a deal-breaker on a field the person has not answered themselves (the log names the field, the screen knows it).

get.summary: Whom the caller seeks and the age window
get.description: The two hard filters of rule 7 as the person set them; null until onboarding sets them.

put.summary: Set whom the caller seeks, the age window, or both
put.description: Either or both, each replacing its row: a non-empty set of genders, an age window within 18 and 99 with min at most max. Onboarding saves each on its own screen (ADR-010 §13). Hard rows: the round builder never crosses them, in either direction.

404.description: No live account (erased meanwhile).

429.description: change_too_soon: whom one seeks was changed within matching_config change_cadence_days; nothing was saved, and GET /onboarding's nextChange.seeks says from when.
